Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: In the very first turn (Step 1), the WebSurfer incorrectly identified the film as "Happy Death Day 2U (2017)". The film "Happy Death Day 2U" was released in 2019, not 2017. The correct 2017 film is simply "Happy Death Day". This initial hallucination of the sequel title and incorrect release year propagated through the conversation, causing the Planner to repeatedly correct the record and the WebSurfer to fail to provide the accurate, direct answer in the first attempt.
